S1.title: You may have paid twice
S1.intro: If you hold your whole wallet against the reader, more than one card can be read. You can check this in your banking app and on the OVpay website.
steps: Open your banking app and look for more than one payment for the same trip. The description starts with NLOV. That is the reference number of your trip.
Only one payment? Then most likely nothing went wrong. TODO: check on ovpay.nl how long it takes before a trip becomes visible.
Two payments? Then look up your trips on the OVpay website using the reference number from your banking app.
TODO: check on ovpay.nl how to request a correction or refund and within what period.
Did you carry another card or phone? Check the payments on that one as well.
S1.helpExtra: TODO: check what a service point can and cannot do about a double payment.

S2.title: You forgot to check out
S2.intro: If you do not check out, the transport company does not know where your trip ended. You can ask for a correction.
steps: Write down which card or phone you checked in with, on what date and at which station.
In your banking app, find the payment with a description that starts with NLOV.
Request a correction. TODO: check on ovpay.nl where you do this and what details you need.
TODO: check on ovpay.nl within how many days you can request a correction.
Cannot do it online? Go to a service point in the station.
S2.helpExtra: TODO: check whether each transport company (NS, GVB) has its own place to do this.

S3.title: The gate did not open or showed a red cross
S3.intro: A red cross means the reader did not accept your card. There can be several reasons.
steps: Step aside so other travellers can pass. Then calmly try again.
Take one card or your phone out of your wallet and hold only that against the reader.
Use the same card or phone you checked in with. Another card will not work to check out.
Gate still closed? Ask a member of staff or go to a service point in the station.
TODO: check on ovpay.nl which causes there are (for example too little balance or a blocked card) and what the reader shows.
S3.helpExtra: TODO: check what to do if the gate stays closed when you check out and you need to leave the station.

S4.button: I do not know which card I used
S4.title: Which card did I use?
S4.intro: You have to check out with the same card or phone you checked in with. If you do not, your trip stays open.
steps: In your banking app, look for an account with a payment that starts with NLOV.
Do you pay with your phone or watch? Then check which card is set as the default card.
Still not sure? Check out with the card you use most and then check whether the trip is correct.
TODO: check on ovpay.nl how you can see which card started a trip.
In doubt, go to a service point. Bring all the cards you had with you.
S4.helpExtra: TODO: check whether staff can look up which card you checked in with.

S5.button: I want to check my trip or payment
S5.title: Check your trip or payment
S5.intro: Every OVpay trip has a reference number. That is a code starting with NLOV that appears with the payment in your banking app. You use that number to look up your trip.
steps: Open your banking app and find the payment for your trip.
In the description or details, look for the code starting with NLOV. That is the reference number.
Write the number down or copy it.
Go to the OVpay website and enter the reference number to see your trips. TODO: check on ovpay.nl which page this is and what other details you need.
Something not right? TODO: check on ovpay.nl how to request a correction.
S5.helpExtra: TODO: check what to do if you cannot find a reference number in your banking app.

checkin.title: How to check in safely
checkin.intro: These three steps prevent most problems.

steps.title: Take one card out of your wallet
steps.text: Do not hold your whole wallet against the reader. Another card than you intend may be read.

steps.title: Hold the card against the reader
steps.text: Wait at the reader until you hear a beep or see a green tick. Then it worked.

steps.title: Check out with the same card
steps.text: When you get off, use exactly the same card or phone as when you checked in.
